_comment:
Dasa pane commands and options (tests/dasaCommands.test.ts reads golden/jhora-dasa-commands/<variant>/). Tab 1 captures plain nakshatra dasas, then posts 32971 'Use Tribhagi variation' (a session toggle: the modes after it, labelled 'Tribhagi <system>', are captured with Tribhagi on; no dasa_levels there because the level reset re-posts the mode command). Tab 2 runs with Tribhagi still on and captures the antardasas of the first Tribhagi Vimsottari maha dasa. Tabs 3-4: the rasi / other dasas whose options are ini keys. Run once per variant (capture.py --ini replaces every line of an array key, so one run sets one slot) and restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini afterwards:
  python tools/harness/capture.py --jhora <copy> --views tools/harness/views-dasa-commands.json --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/default golden/charts/*.jhd
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/narayana-d9 --ini NarayanaDasaChart=1
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/paryaaya-d9 --ini ParyaayaDasaChart=1
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/lagnamsaka-d1 --ini LagnamsakaDasaChart=0
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/moola-no-lagna --ini LagnaUsedInMoolaDasa=0
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/moola-no-moon --ini MoonUsedInMoolaDasa=0
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/moola-mt0 --ini MoolaDasaNoCorrectionInMoolaTrikona=1
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/vimsottari-shift1 --ini "NakshatraDasaShift=0 1"
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/vimsottari-reverse --ini "AntiZodiacalDasa=0 1"
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/saptarshi-shift3 --ini "NakshatraDasaShift=12 3"
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-commands/kalachakra-lagna --ini "NakshatraDasaStartPoint=2 4"
